desc: Reliable rotary magazine designed specifically for the Winchester Wildcat autoloading and Xpert bolt-action rifles. Always keep a spare magazine at hand. The Wildcat/Xpert magazine features a lightweight polymer body and metal feed lips for long service life and reliable ammo feeding. For Wildcat autoloading rifle owners, the integrated bolt stop automatically activates after the last round has been fired to lock the bolt open for faster reloading.
